title: Quarterly Private Fleet readiness & cadence: cross-team roadmap and OKR alignment
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Purpose: Establish a clear, actionable quarterly roadmap for Private Fleet (VPC & on-prem) that ties feature-level work to top-line OKRs, delivery cadence, and runbook readiness. Goals: 1) Produce a prioritized feature plan that balances regulatory customers' needs with runtime capacity constraints; 2) Define measurable acceptance criteria and SLO checkpoints for each initiative; 3) Create a cross-team handoff and communication cadence (PM <> Eng <> Design <> Sales) to reduce integration churn during onboarding windows. Scope: roadmap for Q2 that includes upgrade windows, KMS/HSM integrations, tenant isolation controls, rollout gating criteria, and a customer migration plan. Out of scope: public Hosted API features, standalone console UX experiments not required for activation, and any infra-heavy rewrites that would push delivery past Q3. Trade-offs considered: prioritize small, gated deliverables that reduce customer activation friction over larger monolithic features that delay time-to-value. Contingency: maintain a minimal canary lane for high-risk tenants and a fast rollback policy. Success metrics: defined OKR targets (see okrs), 75% of prioritized customers with migration playbooks prepared, and <2 P1 incidents related to private onboarding during the quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap doc published and shared with stakeholders by 2026-03-15
Feature-level acceptance criteria and test plans attached for top 6 items
Signed handoff checklist for infra, security, and ops for each release tranche
Customer migration playbook templates created for top 5 enterprise customers
OKR targets mapped to initiatives and visible in the PM dashboard
okrs: OKR-1: Reduce Private Fleet onboarding time from 8 weeks to 5 weeks (KR: automated preflight checks and one-click compliance checklist)
OKR-2: Achieve 99.9% availability for Dedicated/VPC routes during scheduled activation windows
OKR-3: Reduce average inference unit cost by 12% for private deployments through batching and cache recommendations
